message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This isolated DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`. The scan window was **2026-10-06 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-07 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-06 13:10 IST through 2026-10-07 13:10 IST**).

One confirmed MongoDB ecosystem finding was newly updated or surfaced in the window. No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed against an exact component/package name and version in the DLL list. Two fresh Kiota-family CVEs are retained separately because the affected generator packages are related to, but not the same as, the listed Kiota runtime packages.

### Confirmed finding

**1. MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes improper Ops Manager configuration validation — CVE-2026-103546**
- **Affected product:** MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes before 1.13.0, when using Enterprise Ops Manager backup reconciliation.
- **Severity:** Low, CVSS 4.0 score 2.3, in the MongoDB CNA record; the record also provides a CVSS 3.1 score of 4.3 (Medium).
- **Description:** A user able to modify an `OpsManager` custom resource may use insufficiently validated backup configuration to cause unintended administrative changes in Ops Manager.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB Kubernetes and Ops Manager component found during the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep. It is not an entry in the DLL file itself.
- **Freshness:** The original CVE record was published on October 5, but NVD materially updated it on October 6 at 14:17 UTC and GitHub surfaced it on October 6, within this run's 24-hour window.
- **Sources:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-103546), [MongoDB Kubernetes 1.13.0 release](https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes/releases/tag/1.13.0)

### Possible matches needing review

**Microsoft Kiota generator — CVE-2026-105796**
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 8.8.
- **Description:** A malicious or tampered OpenAPI description can escape generated Java or PHP documentation comments, leading to code execution if the generated output is subsequently loaded or compiled.
- **Mapping uncertainty:** The advisory affects `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota` and `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota.Builder` versions 0.5.0 through 1.34.1. The DLL inventory lists `Microsoft.Kiota.*` runtime packages at 1.17.1, not either affected generator package. Review build dependencies before treating this as applicable.
- **Source:** [GitHub advisory GHSA-rm89-rhwj-9j92](https://github.com/microsoft/kiota/security/advisories/GHSA-rm89-rhwj-9j92)

**Microsoft Kiota generator — CVE-2026-105795**
- **Severity:** Low, CVSS 3.1 score 3.1.
- **Description:** Kiota can copy an unsafe `oauth_card_path` from an untrusted OpenAPI description into a generated plugin manifest, allowing a downstream consumer to resolve a path outside the intended plugin package.
- **Mapping uncertainty:** The advisory affects `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota` and `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota.Builder` versions 1.25.1 through 1.34.1. Those packages are not explicitly listed; only related `Microsoft.Kiota.*` runtime packages appear in the DLL inventory.
- **Source:** [GitHub advisory GHSA-6gw6-rv2g-25mg](https://github.com/microsoft/kiota/security/advisories/GHSA-6gw6-rv2g-25mg)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator and Controllers for Kubernetes, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and maintained libraries. CVE-2026-103546 was the only credible MongoDB-family item newly updated or surfaced in the exact window.

### Review priority

First confirm whether MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes versions below 1.13.0 are deployed with Enterprise Ops Manager backup reconciliation. Separately, check build manifests for `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota` or `Microsoft.OpenApi.Kiota.Builder`; the high-severity Kiota issue warrants prompt review only if either generator package is present.
